breaking_changes.description: The 'auth' config option no longer accepts a plain string. It now requires an object with 'username' and 'password' fields.
breaking_changes.migration_notes: Replace any string-form auth config with the object form: { username, password }.

deprecations.description: Direct mutation of defaults.transformRequest is deprecated. Use axios.create() with a custom transformRequest instead.

summary: The axios 1.4.0 → 1.7.2 delta includes one breaking change to the auth config format (now requires an object instead of a string) introduced in 1.6.0, and one deprecation of direct defaults mutation planned for removal in 2.0.0.
